notes.title: Update #1: English Subtitles and Auto-saving
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for the support thus far! 

I will try my best to add frequent, free, updates to the game based on the feedback and suggestions of players. 

English Subtitles have now been implemented into the game for everyone, as well as an auto-save feature so that you never lose progress if your game crashes or you forget to save. 

The game is meant to be played strictly with keyboard and mouse but if enough requests are made for controller support, I will try my best to implement that into the game as well.

- Jordan
